يخضار (form XI)
# يَخْضَارُّ (yaḵḍārru) /jax.dˤaːr.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْضَارَّ (iḵḍārra)
# يَخْضَارَّ (yaḵḍārra) /jax.dˤaːr.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْضَارَّ (iḵḍārra)
# يَخْضَارِّ (yaḵḍārri) /jax.dˤaːr.ri/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِخْضَارَّ (iḵḍārra)
